brief:
A Palestinian young man was killed and a woman and child wounded by gunfire from Israeli forces in the al-Batn al-Sameen area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza on Monday evening, the Palestine News Network reported.

The incident occurred in the residential district. No additional information was available on what prompted the shooting or the extent of injuries to the woman and child.
dek: GAZA /PNN/ A Palestinian young man was killed and a woman and a child were injured by Israeli occupation forces' gunfire in the al-Batn al-Sameen area of Khan Younis, south of the Gaza Strip, on Monday evening.
title: Israeli gunfire kills Palestinian youth in Khan Younis
